title: Relaxing Cholesky to LU lets GW finish but the numbers stay garbage
symptom: With use_cholesky_gw_wc=f (LU) MnTe completed in 8h47m yet produced GW energies of -8400..-24000 eV.
root_cause: The solver relaxation only removes the positive-definiteness requirement; it does not repair an indefinite/broken W. 'The program completed' is not a correctness certificate.
minimal_fix: Fix the upstream matrix (see 3d-full-ewald-coulomb-strongly-indefinite) and keep PSD gates mandatory; allow LU only as a diagnostic to see how far a non-PD matrix propagates.
validation: Direct-reciprocal Coulomb: all q PSD and physical GW values on the same system.
avoid: Reporting a completed-but-absurd run as partial success; or burning a big allocation on LU runs of a known-indefinite matrix.

parameters.use_cholesky_gw_wc: diagnostic only; fix the matrix instead
